definitions.explanation: In a relaxed, composed manner without rushing. Implies having plenty of time or being untroubled.
With a comfortable margin; without difficulty.

examples.japanese: {悠々|ゆうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悠々|ゆうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき}→悠々自適：18215_yuuyuujiteki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To live a comfortable retirement doing as one pleases.

examples.english: I cleared the time limit with ease.

examples.english: Only 50 people came for a capacity of 100, so we could sit comfortably with room to spare.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {悠々|ゆうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb (leisurely, calmly)
- {悠々|ゆうゆう}たる + noun (literary, leisurely)
- ⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき}→悠々自適：18215_yuuyuujiteki⟧ (living a leisurely, self-indulgent life)

USAGE:
- When describing actions: unhurried, at ease
- When describing achievements: with room to spare, easily

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧ (leisurely, in a carefree manner)
- ⟦ゆったり→ゆったり：05841_yuttari⟧ (relaxed, loose)
- ⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (with room to spare)

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{悠々|ゆうゆう}{自適|じてき}→悠々自適：18215_yuuyuujiteki⟧ is a common expression for the ideal retirement lifestyle.
